contract.statement: spatial_stats.py emits ONLY additive sufficient statistics, under column-name suffixes that aggregate_to_mouse.classify_columns() already recognises. aggregate_to_mouse.py is NOT modified. Every ratio, median, quantile and enrichment is recomputed AFTER pooling, in spatial_mouse_metrics.py, from mouse_level_summary.csv.

stage_s2_spatial_summary_csv._note: one row per (image, region, section_id, panel). For the WSI route image = section_id = slide stem, matching the slide row aggregate_tiles_to_slide.py writes at its lines 266-267.

columns.column: mouse_id | genotype | condition | panel | image | region | section_id | output_key
columns.meaning: aggregate_to_mouse KEY_COLS + ROW_ID_COLS; the join key and the mouse key.
class-A cells whose nearest class-B cell is <= bin upper edge AND that are >= that radius from the window boundary. Numerator of the reduced-sample cross-type G function.
class-A cells >= bin upper edge from the window boundary. Denominator of G. Shrinks with r; that shrinkage IS the edge correction.
class-B cells within R um of an eligible focal class-F cell, summed over focal cells.
all cells within R um of the same focal cells. Denominator of composition.
closed-form random-labelling expectation of the numerator: sum over focal i of m_i * (N_B - [i in B]) / (N_pool - 1). Additive, so observed/expected pools exactly.
eligible focal cells (>= R um from the window boundary).
cumulative translation-corrected weighted pair count out to the bin upper edge. Numerator of Ripley cross-K.
same, for the ANNULUS only. Numerator of the pair correlation g(r).
border/reduced-sample comparator. QC only: a large disagreement with the translation estimator at small r means the window raster is wrong.
n_A * n_B / |W| for this slide. K = sum(S) / sum(D) is the ratio-unbiased pooled estimator for replicated patterns; the denominator must be summed, never averaged.
point counts entering K (n_a is post-subsampling).
class-A cells whose distance to the nearest structure pixel falls in the bin.
AVAILABLE tissue area at that distance from the structure. The denominator that makes distance-to-structure an enrichment rather than a restatement of how much damaged tissue exists.
cells beyond the last bin edge (the EDT is capped there). Censored, not zero.
cells whose centroid fell outside the window raster. Must be ~0; non-zero means the window is wrong.
total area of the structure mask on this slide.
retained, de-duplicated points in the analysed region.
cells with an evaluable call, i.e. the pool the random-labelling null permutes over.
cells excluded because the engine's three-state call was indeterminate. In a real ALI run this was 76% for AcTub; treating those as negatives would have been a fabrication.
area of the analysis window. Its mouse-level _positive_area_fraction (vs pooled region_area_um2) is the reconciliation QC; expect ~0.8-1.2.

columns.column: spatial_profile | spatial_bin_signature | spatial_window_mode | spatial_edge_correction | spatial_null_model | spatial_eligible_pool | spatial_query_fraction_* | spatial_perm_p_* | <STRUCT>_structure_source
columns.meaning: NOT aggregated by design. spatial_perm_p_* is a WITHIN-SLIDE random-labelling p-value: valid for 'is this association non-random in THIS animal', invalid as a group test. Deliberately dropped before mouse level so it cannot become one.

stage_s4_spatial_mouse_metrics_csv._note: one row per (mouse_id, genotype, condition, panel, metric). Every value is RECOMPUTE from pooled sums; nothing here is summed further.

columns.meaning: pooled cross-type nearest-neighbour CDF = sum(nn count) / sum(nn eligible).
quantile read off the POOLED G curve by linear interpolation. Never a mean of per-slide medians.
sum(neighbour) / sum(total neighbour): what fraction of the cells around F are B.
sum(observed) / sum(expected under random labelling). 1.0 = no spatial association. This is the effect size to compare across mice.
sum(S) / sum(D), translation corrected.
sqrt(K/pi) - r. > 0 clustered, < 0 regular, RELATIVE TO CSR -- which is not the biological null. Interpret with the random-labelling enrichment, not alone.
pair correlation from the annulus form.
share of class-A cells in that distance bin.
share of tissue area in that distance bin.
cellfrac / areafrac. THE distance-to-structure endpoint. 1.0 = cells are distributed exactly as the tissue is. This is the 'CD8 AT the pod' number, area-normalised.
THE statistical n. Not sections, not slides, not tiles, not cells.
mean across MICE of the per-mouse pooled value.
BLANK when n_mice = 1. aggregate_to_mouse._stats() returns 0.0 there (its lines 353-356); that zero is an absent variance estimate, not a small one, and is not written out as a number.
'no' when n_mice < --min-n (default 3). At the current pilot (n=1 per group cell) every row is 'no'.

keys.meaning: cross-tile fragments merged. Expect ~0.35% on this study.
upper bound on coincidental merges, from the (merge, 2*merge] annulus. Reported, never subtracted.
tile-corner fragments split three or four ways.
area-weighted centroid correction applied to merged nuclei.
must be 0. Non-zero means the per-tile RoiSet was not applied and halo cells are double counted.
must be 0. Guards against a second tile-origin definition drifting from aggregate_tiles_to_slide.collect_cell_centroids().
